Way too small for me, but it is better for small makeup like eyeliners and lipsticks. When I first ordered my organizer it came in with a hairline crack. After I contacted them about it they were very helpful. They sent a new one and this one had a crack as well. I am thinking this has something to do with the way the organizer it was handled but then again there were no pieces from the b

reviews.t: Great gift for my particular mother-in-law!
reviews.x: I bought this for my mother-in-law for her birthday and she loves it!  Thank goodness...we hit a home run!  She says the liner is the best part and it keeps things from sliding around.  She was looking for a second Lucite container, little did I know, to match one she bought about 40 years ago!  This one happened to match and I win daughter-in-law of the year!  Or at least of the month.  I'm sure I'll dig myself another hole to climb out of.  She uses this for storing....jewelry!  So she can see

reviews.t: Looks like picture. Arrived quickly and in good condition
reviews.x: Looks like picture. Arrived quickly and in good condition.  Slightly smaller than I estimated, and not all of the spaces are usable for what I had hoped. "Lipstick" areas are small, so very few products actually stand there.  Drawers are not as deep as I imagined,  so they only fit a couple items each. But it does keep everything organized and it looks nice.

I absolutely love these! I have a small bathroom with very little drawer/cabinet space and these are perfect! I actually used this one to add to my previous set! They don't fit together with some of the other similar sets, but I was able to adjust them to make them fit. Everyone that sees them loves how neat and organized everything is! Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Finally some organization to my makeup madness
reviews.x: This is just the right size. I wanted something that would sit on the back of my toilet (I have a tiny bathroom) and this was the perfect size. You can take the black lining off and rinse in the sink to keep your organizer looking clean! Also great price as even at Ross or TJ Max these sell for around $20-$25.

I absolutely love this acrylic makeup organizer! I am quite a collector and conesuer of this type of product! I have them all over the house! Especially in cabinets, on vanities, in bathrooms- really all over the place! I usually don't know what exactly to expect when I order these. Some acrylic is milky looking and cheap looking. I find that a good acrylic organizer appears to be like a crystal or glass. This case looks like that! I am so pleased with the glass like shine and ultra clear look.

I originally bought one like this from another company. It was perfect so I ordered another. This product from this place is a piece junk. The acrylic has sharp edges, the drawers go off track easily so you can't close them, the bottom makes it so it easily slides all over and the top is cut wrong so it doesn't even fit snugly. I do not recommend nor will I purchase from this place again.

This item is exactly what I was wanting, if not better than what I was looking for! It allows me to leave my frequently used items on the counter without looking tacky and disorganized. It feels pretty sturdy (I have 3 mostly full spray bottles sitting in the top, along with several other things) and it has great options for me to organize my items in a way that suits my needs.

but I do wear a little make-up.  This organizer is perfect for my needs - it holds multiple containers of eye shadow/mascara/lipstick, manicure scissors, nail clippers, foundation, concealer and even a pair of glasses for my old eyes!  It's a sturdy compact organizer that holds a lot.
Great product! It was packaged appropriately and arrived on time. Great for keeping cosmetics organized as well as nail polish, hair clips/ hair ties etc! Overall satisfied with the product.

This is a fantastic way to organize my makeup.  This is actually the second one that I have bought because I had such a mess.  My husband was getting grumpy about my bathroom organization so I bought these to help.  The top part works perfectly for my brushes, foundations and some of my lipsticks.  The drawers work great for my hair ties, smaller eye shadow palettes, and blushes.  I feel like I am much more organized than I was and it also looks much nicer.  I like that the drawers are clear so

This would work if you had a small makeup collection, maybe for teenagers or beginners, but there is not way I could've fit all my cosmetics in there. I easily have 25 brushes and over $500+ in makeup, I would need 3 of these. But even if I did buy 3, I don't feel the drawer are large enough to fit more than one compact each, and the compartments up top are pretty small. I read the measurements and thought I'd still try it but it just wouldn't work. I think the overall build and quality is great

reviews.t: Organising make up just got easier.
reviews.x: Portable yet very accommodating, the transparency helps you to see through and makes it beautiful at the same time colorful, the black pad helps prevent breakage. The sections help me know what's where, I don't need to look for any thing, they all have their placed. Well thought out design. Love it especially the fact that it's not space consuming, sits perfectly on my bathroom shelf.

reviews.t: It is like the picture and a great size as to not ...
reviews.x: It is like the picture and a great size as to not monopolize the counter space but hold a lot. However, I had assumed the lining was going to be permanently in the drawers. Since it isn't, the fabric tends to curl a little unless the drawer is filled. It does offer the opportunity to remove them if one doesn't want them.

I bought this as a gift for my daughter for Christmas. She loves it! There is enough room in the cosmetic organizer to keep all her things exactly where they need to be. The case is durable, easy to clean, fashionable and affordable. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for make up case/organizer.

I'm very happy with this purchase. It was very well packaged (so everything was in perfect condition when I received it) and it was exactly what I expected based on the pictures. My dresser is much neater now that all of my makeup is stored in one place! I would definitely recommend purchasing this product!

reviews.t: Nice bedside organizer for keeping my essential oils.
reviews.x: This little organizer works great on my bedside table for organizing my essential oils.  The top is not attached & the drawers are a little wobbly when opening but overall it is a nice product. I would order it again & have recommended it to others.  For the price point it was just what I was looking for.

reviews.t: ... smaller than I was expecting but nontheless it is beautiful and holds my make up perfectly
reviews.x: The organiner was a little smaller than I was expecting but nontheless it is beautiful and holds my make up perfectly.  I like how it has seperate drawers to keep your eyeshadow,blush,and other make up seperated. All in all a nice little organizer I will be buying more of to complete me collection.

Nice small makeup organizer. The black lining inside slips pretty easily but once you put the makeup in they shouldn't really move. I wish some of drawers were a little deaper, as you cant stack products. However its nice if you have more makeup than can fit in a makeup bag but not a crazy amount.

My family members like it so much (after seeing that I have a very organized makeup area) I was requested to buy not 1, not 2, but THREE of these items for them, all separate and desperate requests. It is a must for all holidays. It is a family favorite. 10/10, would recommend to everyone.

Arrived quickly, packaged well. I love this little organizer. It fits perfectly in my bathroom cabinet and holds all my makeup very well. I wouldn't recommend this to someone who has a ton of makeup because its not huge but it works perfectly for my needs and it feels solid.

My sister bought it first. I loved it then and love it even more now!! The small drawers make nice compartments to keep my make-up organized. It's transparent so makes it easy to find what you need and forces you to keep it neat and clutter free. Love it!!!

this is adorable organizer that i organize my skin care and jewelry with. doesn't really have grip at the bottom so it used to slide around a lot but here's a tip for that; apply dollops of super glue on the corners and tah dah! not a problem anymore :)

Like others have said it is a little small but it holds more than I really need.  It seems to be well made, a sturdy good looking piece that keeps everything organized.  I might purchase another set to stack underneath just to hold a few more pieces.

reviews.t: absolutely perfect for my concealers and makeup brushes since i have ...
reviews.x: absolutely perfect for my concealers and makeup brushes since i have multiple beauty box subscriptions i have lots of makeup and need this organisation , my makeup is now all organized and I love it! really good quality and looks great on my vanity.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the organizer sturdy, well-made, and good value, praising its quality and durability.
Reviewers frequently say it is great for organizing makeup and keeping items in place, with removable liners that help prevent sliding and are easy to clean.
A common complaint is that the organizer is smaller than expected, with shallow drawers and small lipstick sections that limit what fits.
Several reviewers note it works well for small spaces and small collections, but some say it is too small for larger makeup collections.
A few reviewers report quality or condition issues such as cracks, sharp edges, drawers going off track, and liners that curl.
